# Changeset.NET

> An immutable Ecto-style cast, validate, inspect, and apply pipeline for untrusted input in C# and .NET 10.

Changeset.NET uses explicit field allowlists, type coercion, composable validation,
structured errors, and an explicit materialization step. The core package does not
mutate a model during casting or validation.

Important semantics: most validators inspect only values in `Changes`;
`ValidateRequired` also rejects absent values. Core `ApplyChanges` creates a new
object for updates, while EF Core `ApplyTo` mutates the tracked entity.

## Start here

- [Getting Started](getting-started/): Install the package and build complete create and update pipelines.

## Core concepts

- [The Changeset Lifecycle](lifecycle/): Understand immutable state, insert/update semantics, and final outcomes.
- [Casting](casting/): Allowlist fields, coerce input types, and configure casting behavior.
- [Validation](validation/): Use built-in, custom, and asynchronous validators.
- [Errors](errors/): Inspect structured errors and map them to application responses.
- [Applying Changes](applying-changes/): Materialize valid inserts and updates and understand copy behavior.
- [Associations](associations/): Cast, validate, and recursively materialize nested input.
